## Why this matters
PR #252 was merged to `main` on 2026-06-14 without closing its R81 audit findings. This issue tracks the outstanding follow-up work. Feature is behind `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_ROMAN_ONBOARDING_POLISH` (default-OFF) so there is no production blast radius today, but the PR is not R81-clean and cannot be flag-flipped until findings are closed.

## What's required
- [ ] **F1 (P2)** D6B host wiring absent — `StripeConnectCard` and `PermanenceMarker` are present as isolated components but not wired into production screens — `src/screens/coach/payments/CoachConnectScreen.tsx` (missing import); no package/pricing host mounts `PermanenceMarker` — fix: mount `StripeConnectCard` in the real Stripe Connect host; mount `PermanenceMarker` in real package/pricing saved rows; add host-level flag-off and flag-on tests
- [ ] **F2 (P2)** `StripeConnectCard` CTA still lacks a guaranteed 48dp touch target — `src/components/roman/StripeConnectCard.tsx` (cta style: `paddingVertical: 14`, no `minHeight`) — fix: add `minHeight: 48`, `justifyContent: 'center'`, and/or `hitSlop`; add style assertion pinning the minimum target
- [ ] **F4 (P2)** Inactive card face is not hidden from the accessibility tree — both front and back faces render simultaneously; `pointerEvents` blocks touch but does not hide from screen readers — `src/components/roman/StripeConnectCard.tsx` — fix: add inverse `accessibilityElementsHidden` and `importantForAccessibility="no-hide-descendants"` on the inactive face; sanitize `last4` to `^\d{4}$` before rendering/announcing; add tests proving inactive-face labels are not accessible
- [ ] **F3 (P3)** `romanPRDetected` in `copy.ts` has a dead identical-branch conditional — `src/lib/roman/copy.ts` (`const weightLabel = Number.isInteger(weight) ? String(weight) : String(weight)`) — fix: replace with `String(weight)` or implement the intended integer/non-integer formatting split

## Already resolved
Pre-merge audit + post-merge re-audit complete. Findings list above is verified against current `main`.
